sentences.text: Eskimaspis was an extinct genus of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Early Devonian period.
The genus name Eskimaspis honors the aboriginal Eskimo people of the Canadian Arctic.
This creature lived during the Lochkovian stage, approximately 419.62 to 413.02 million years ago.
The type species Eskimaspis heintzi was described in 1984 from fossils found in the Peel Sound Formation on Prince of Wales Island in Arctic Canada.
Eskimaspis belongs to the class Placodermi and the parent group Arthrodira.
It is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira.
